classes.fingerprint: select u.id, u.name, u.display_name, u.description, t.id as theme_id, t.dark_mode, i.id as icon_id, i.image from users u inner join themes t on t.user_id = u.id left join icons i on i.user_id = u.id where u.id in(?+) order by u.id, t.id, i.id

example.query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.display_name, u.description,
	       t.id AS theme_id, t.dark_mode, i.id AS icon_id, i.image
	FROM users u
	INNER JOIN themes t ON t.user_id = u.id
	LEFT JOIN icons i ON i.user_id = u.id
	WHERE u.id IN (1026, 1018, 1015, 1048, 1044, 1028, 1036, 1042, 1020, 1046, 1031, 1039, 1022, 1033, 1037, 1013, 1024, 1029)
	ORDER BY u.id, t.id, i.id

classes.distillate: SELECT users livestreams reactions livestreams livecomments

example.query:
SELECT u.name AS username,
	       COALESCE(r.total_reactions, 0) + COALESCE(lc.total_tip, 0) AS score,
	       COALESCE(r.total_reactions, 0) AS total_reactions,
	       COALESCE(lc.total_livecomments, 0) AS total_livecomments,
	       COALESCE(lc.total_tip, 0) AS total_tip
	FROM users u
	LEFT JOIN (
	    SELECT l.user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_reactions
	    FROM livestreams l
	    INNER JOIN reactions r ON r.livestream_id = l.id
	    GROUP BY l.user_id
	) r ON r.user_id = u.id
	LEFT JOIN (
	    SELECT l.user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_livecomments, SUM(lc.tip) AS total_tip
	    FROM livestreams l
	    INNER JOIN livecomments lc ON lc.livestream_id = l.id
	    GROUP BY l.user_id
	) lc ON lc.user_id = u.id

example.query:
SELECT l.id AS livestream_id,
	       COALESCE(r.total_reactions, 0) + COALESCE(lc.total_tip, 0) AS score,
	       COALESCE(r.total_reactions, 0) AS total_reactions,
	       COALESCE(lc.max_tip, 0) AS max_tip
	FROM livestreams l
	LEFT JOIN (
	    SELECT livestream_id, COUNT(*) AS total_reactions
	    FROM reactions GROUP BY livestream_id
	) r ON r.livestream_id = l.id
	LEFT JOIN (
	    SELECT livestream_id, SUM(tip) AS total_tip, MAX(tip) AS max_tip
	    FROM livecomments GROUP BY livestream_id
	) lc ON lc.livestream_id = l.id
